PlectaDepthRuleLegacyFloor.what: grey levels; the previous rule's fixed denominator floor

PlectaDepthRuleSaturationCut.what: |s| at or above which the previous rule was structurally unable to abstain

PlectaDepthRuleSatSynthPct.what: per cent of synthetic crossings saturated by that floor

PlectaDepthRuleSatRealPct.what: per cent of real crossings saturated by that floor

PlectaDepthRuleSatBelowNoiseAcc.what: accuracy of saturated crossings whose separation fell below the noise

PlectaDepthRuleSatAboveNoiseAcc.what: accuracy of saturated crossings whose separation cleared the noise

PlectaDepthRuleSharpDecidedPct.what: per cent of real crossings the sharpness channel decided

PlectaDepthRuleSharpKappa.what: Cohen's kappa between the sharpness and the intensity channel

PlectaDepthRuleSharpAccLow.what: low end of the sharpness channel's standalone accuracy

PlectaDepthRuleSharpAccHigh.what: high end of the sharpness channel's standalone accuracy

PlectaDepthRuleAccDelta.what: accuracy difference, one-channel minus two-channel, matched coverage

PlectaDepthRuleAccCILow.what: lower 95 per cent confidence bound on that difference

PlectaDepthRuleAccCIHigh.what: upper 95 per cent confidence bound on that difference

PlectaDepthRuleAucOld.what: AUC of correctness against confidence, previous rule

PlectaDepthRuleAucNew.what: AUC of correctness against |s|, shipped rule

PlectaDepthRuleAucCILow.what: lower 95 per cent confidence bound on the AUC gain

PlectaDepthRuleAucCIHigh.what: upper 95 per cent confidence bound on the AUC gain

PlectaDepthRuleAxialDelta.what: accuracy difference from adding an axial continuity channel

PlectaDepthRuleAxialCILow.what: lower 95 per cent confidence bound on that difference

PlectaDepthRuleAxialCIHigh.what: upper 95 per cent confidence bound on that difference
